Example: blog

28 lines · 2 signal(s) · 1 RPC function(s) · route /

from pyweb import App, server
from pyweb import Model

app = App()

class Post(Model):
    title: str

@server
def latest() -> str:
    return "hello"

@app.page("/")
def Home():
    title = ""
    posts = Post.all()

    def publish():
        Post.create(title=title)
        title = ""

    <main>
        <h1>Blog</h1>
        <input bind={title} placeholder="Post..." />
        <button onclick={publish}>Publish</button>
        for post in posts:
            <article>{post}</article>
    </main>

import { sig, computed, bind_text, bind_input, on, rpc, mutate, liveList, liveIf, takeover, dynText } from './runtime.js';

export const post = sig(null); // pyweb:post
export const title = sig(""); // pyweb:title
export const posts = computed(() => (Post.all())); // deps Post
export function publish(e) { Post.create(title(title())); title('') } // pyweb-line:18
async function latest() {
  return rpc('latest', {});
} // rpc:latest pyweb-line:10
window.__pyweb_scope = { post, posts, publish, title };
export function mount(root=document) {
  // static — no bindings
  bind_input(root, "title", 'pw00001'); // line 24
  on(root, 'click', publish, 'pw00002'); // line 25
  // static — no bindings
  // live-for hid 23 (line 26): SSR rows activate below
  (() => { const __anchor = takeover(root, 23);
    const __row = (post, __i, __key) => {
      const __frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
  bind_text(__frag, "post", () => (post())); // line 27
      return { els: Array.from(__frag.childNodes) }; };
    liveList(__anchor, () => (posts), (__item, __i, __key) => __row(__item, __i, __key), ((post) => (post()))); })();
}
if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => mount(document));
  } else { mount(document); }
}

<main><h1>Blog</h1><input data-pw-id="pw00001" placeholder="Post..."><button data-pw-id="pw00002">Publish</button><!--pw:50396--><article><span pw-bind="post"></span></article><!--/pw:50396--></main>

Placement:
publish → browser event handler reachable from UI, browser-safe deps
post → browser reactive UI state read by markup, mutated by events
title → browser reactive UI state read by markup, mutated by events
posts → browser pure derivation of ['Post'], all inputs local
__page__ → browser+server SSR initial HTML on server, activation in browser
